snippet.title: The Bridge — Trailer
snippet.description:
You have to cross a bridge, but you're too heavy to go on. 
What will you leave behind?

Available @ interactivedreams.itch.io/thebridge

"Je Te Veux" composed by Erik Satie, played by Luis Kolodin, 2020. Licenced under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0. The song was modified to fit the video.
